title: BusMA: A Bus Communication Substrate for Multi-Agent Systems
mechanism: Add intent-tagged shared-memory bus messages (discussion/challenge/guidance/request-explanation) so subagents can post to and query a common channel instead of only reporting back to the orchestrator, letting any Fable-launched agent directly address a specific peer agent mid-task

expected_gain.metric: cross-agent task success rate on multi-agent workflows, %
expected_gain.rationale: chitta already has msg_* cross-harness messaging and agent_upsert/get/list/disable (agent registry) per inventory §4, but no documented typed-intent bus or Chair-style convergence monitor, so the gap is intent structure + convergence coordination, not messaging transport itself

cost.scope: chitta-mcp/server.py msg_* handlers, agent registry tools, Workflow orchestration layer

evidence.claim: BusMA introduces a shared Bus with agent registration, message routing, and shared memory management (abstract)
Four typed intents (discussion, challenge, guidance, request-explanation) enable fine-grained peer communication (abstract)
A Chair agent monitors shared memory to coordinate Workers and facilitate convergence (abstract)
